subject: MAP: POC environment setup - VPC peering, SSO/SAML, KMS & IP allowlists
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment setup - VPC peering, SSO/SAML, KMS & IP allowlists

Thanks for the call earlier today — quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions so we can align the MAP milestones:

Summary of needs (from Acme):
- VPC peering between Acme-prod-vpc and Redwood-POC-vpc (private connectivity)
- IP allowlist for PoC ingress (we will provide specific ranges)
- SSO via SAML (Okta) — metadata and ACS URL required
- Customer-managed KMS for secrets (we prefer to use our AWS KMS CMK; need any Redaction/KeyDetect implications)

Questions / dependencies:
1) Do you require a specific CIDR range for the peering side or can we accept the VPC as-is?
2) For IP allowlist, do you support both static IP ranges and NAT gateway ranges?
3) For KMS, does Redwood need access to decrypt or can we rely on envelope encryption with a bridged key?

Proposed target: We'd like to get the PoC environment fully provisioned and validated by Aug 20 so we can start ingestion tests the week of Aug 23.

Attaching our network diagram (acme-network-diagram.png) and SSO owner contact details in a follow-up.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Lee
Senior Cloud Architect, Acme Corp
jordan.lee@acme.com

Hi Jordan / Priya — thanks for the clear list. I uploaded a first-pass MAP draft ("MAP-draft-v2.pdf") and a short PoC access checklist. Key milestones and owners are called out in the doc, but TL;DR below so we have a single thread for coordination:

MAP milestone (PoC environment setup) — draft: 
- Milestone: Provision VPC peering
  - Owner: Acme (network team)
  - Redwood support: Provide target VPC config & peer request template
  - Target due: 2026-08-07
- Milestone: IP allowlist configured (PoC ingress)
  - Owner: Acme (netops)
  - Redwood support: Provide egress IP ranges & test endpoints
  - Target due: 2026-08-05
- Milestone: SSO/SAML integration (Okta)
  - Owner: Acme (SSO team / Priya)
  - Redwood support: Provide SP metadata, ACS URL, test users
  - Target due: 2026-08-10
- Milestone: KMS / secrets management
  - Owner: Acme Security (customer-managed key)
  - Redwood support: KMS integration guide and limited-access IAM role; we can support either CMK or Redwood-managed keys depending on compliance needs
  - Target due: 2026-08-12

Dependencies / blockers we flagged on the call:
- Need Acme netops contact and specific CIDR/IP ranges for allowlist
- Need Okta SAML metadata and SSO test user(s)
- Need confirmation on KMS model (CMK vs Redwood-managed) and any approvals for cross-account roles

Next steps / immediate asks (this week):
1) Jordan/Priya: please confirm netops and SSO owners and drop contact info (I included Rishi and Nikhil from our infra/ops teams to help coordinate).
2) Acme: upload the network diagram and any current VPC config (thanks for sending acme-network-diagram.png).
3) Redwood: I'll update the MAP and send a DocuSign-friendly version once we lock milestones — target to send v3 by 2026-08-03.

I've attached: MAP-draft-v2.pdf, poc-access-checklist.xlsx

Onward — Marissa

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment setup - VPC peering, SSO/SAML, KMS & IP allowlists

Thanks — quick technical clarifications from infra: 
1) For VPC peering we usually ask for the exact VPC ID and the primary CIDR block. Can you share Acme-prod-vpc ID + route table notes?
2) For IP allowlist, we support both specific CIDR blocks and a set of NAT egress IPs. If Acme is behind dynamic NATs we'll need the public ranges or a small static NAT pool to avoid fragility during testing.
3) For KMS: if you want to use an Acme CMK, we'll need the key ARN and a cross-account grant/CMK policy that allows Redwood's role to decrypt during the PoC. If you prefer Redwood-managed, we'll document the data residency and rotation windows.

Rishi — looping you in to help with routing/peering ops if you have bandwidth.

-Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai

Thanks Marissa — confirming details from Acme side:
- Netops contact: Jordan (cc'd) will provide VPC ID and route table by EOD tomorrow (2026-08-03).
- IP ranges: we can provide a static NAT egress pool (13.52.120.0/29 and 52.15.200.0/29) for the PoC. Let us know if you need anything else for IP allowlist.
- SSO: Okta team will share SAML metadata (IdP metadata XML) and two test users by 2026-08-06. I will be the SSO owner for this PoC.
- KMS: We prefer to use our AWS CMK (key ARN will be provided). We will need a short integration doc from Redwood outlining required IAM permissions to allow cross-account decrypt for the PoC.

I'll upload the network diagram to the shared HubSpot file and reply once VPC ID is posted.

-Priya
